title: USD-pegged stablecoins are taking a growing share of Latin America's crypto activity, serving as a store of value and an efficient cross-border payment system (Maria Clara Cobo/Bloomberg)
summary: Maria Clara Cobo / Bloomberg: USD-pegged stablecoins are taking a growing share of Latin America's crypto activity, serving as a store of value and an efficient cross-border payment system — Stablecoins are proving useful not only as a store of value but as a payment system — including for users who don't know anything about the blockchain.
